All of this is, I think, very well expressed. I've been in the same state
for about a week now. And now that I've come out, I realize that there were
certain things I had no clue about:

1\. I didn't know how to use the word "hapax".

2\. I didn't know there were people who had the exact same reaction as me.

3\. I didn't know how many people actually believe in the idea of a single
"future".

4\. I didn't know that "the future does not matter as much as the present"
is a well-known, and fairly controversial, idea.

5\. I didn't know there were people who are like me.

I will say, however, that there are certain things I did know about, and
these are as follows:

1\. This essay and my reaction to it do not represent the opinions of all
those who read it.

2\. There are other things people do not know, but that they should.

3\. This essay was written by me, on a subject I knew little about.

If the author had read this post, he would have been aware that these things
are all true. He would also have read this post and this post, and seen that
there are many similar opinions about it. He might have known that people
shared his opinion without knowing it, or that people have the exact same
reaction as him, or that people exist who think exactly as he does. He might
have read this blog, and seen that people in this community have the exact
same reaction as him, that many people share his exact same opinion, and so
on. He might have known that many people share the exact same opinion as him,
and that many people have the exact same reaction as him. He might have known
that his response is normal, and that other people share this response.

In short, the author would have come to know a lot more about himself and
others through this post than he would have had he not read it.

The point of this post is to show that many of the things people don't know
about themselves can be found out about through reading, and in the best case
this can be a very useful exercise. The author of this essay was not looking
for knowledge, and would have been very disappointed to have found it, but I
believe that he would have learned a great deal from it.

I, however, have learned a great deal from it, and I've learned a great deal
from reading other people's reactions to it.

If this essay helps you understand yourself, or if you want to understand
others, I think that is a good thing.
